summary.text: Lukas Maughan is the Democratic candidate for the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 43, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A paralegal, he lists supporting public schools and educators, removing financial influence from state government and making housing more affordable as his key campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Lukas Maughan earned a bachelor's degree from Minnesota State University, Moorhead in 2023 and has worked as a paralegal.

Ballotpedia lists him as a Democratic candidate for North Dakota House of Representatives District 45 in 2018, when incumbents Mary Johnson and Tom Kading defeated him and Tim Hoye in the general election.
Maughan advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is running to help change a state government that he said has moved in the wrong direction, and he named public transportation, infrastructure and environmental protections among his policy interests.
He listed endorsements from Dem-NPL, the Red River Valley Democratic Socialists of America, Planned Parenthood, the ND AFL-CIO and the Center for Freethought Equality.
